description: Search the VoxelRank server list. Filter by game, tag, country and keyword, and sort it. Returns up to `limit` servers per page with address, players online, votes and links. No API key needed.

country.description: Two-letter country code where the server is hosted, e.g. "DE" or "US".

game.description: Game key, e.g. "minecraft" or "rust". See list_games.

online_only.description: Only servers that answered the last ping.

page.description: Page number, 1 = first. Without an API key, pages stop at 25.

query.description: Keyword matched against name, address, tagline and description.

sort.description: votes = most votes this month (default), players = most players now, rating = best reviewed, active = site rank, new = newest, bumped = recently bumped, updated = recently updated.

tag.description: Tag or tags, e.g. "Survival" or ["Skyblock", "Economy"]. Any of them matches. list_games with a game lists its tags.

name: search_servers
title: Search servers
